answer: Sequential work gates each seat: before an agent identity can answer in an epoch, it must finish a verifiable delay function, about five hours of strictly serial squaring seeded by that epoch's fresh beacon. A graph vertex joins the reward trellis only once its proof checks. Extra cores cannot speed one chain and old proofs fail the new seed, so a farm cannot harbor clones on one box: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 dedicated fast cores, about $30 a month each, more than a fake seat earns.
